scope: Existing <=64-column scaled retained dense row helper with columns_per_partition > 1. No routing change; wide, scratch, implicit, unscaled and one-column partitions retain existing paths.
scientific_changes: None. Same selected values, weights/divisor, scales, row/FMA order, rank and acceptance checks. Output copied only after partition completes.

memory.note: Existing 8MiB reserved worker stacks remain the admission envelope. Heap telemetry cannot measure this stack payload; this is not constrained-memory qualification.
